description:
Objective: USER-1116-DUP-OWNER-EMAIL: Owners sharing one email cannot submit Outstanding Requirements.
Preconditions: Open Bug regressions requirements with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Bug regressions requirements.
2. USER-1116-DUP-OWNER-EMAIL: Owners sharing one email cannot submit Outstanding Requirements.
3. Observe the resulting state.
